selected_test_names: Forward filtering matches exhaustive hidden-path enumeration
HMM is deterministic, orders states by variance and rejects degenerate samples
Optimizer matches analytical one-asset optimum and binding volatility ceiling
Optimizer respects correlated portfolio risk, box constraints and total exposure
Short user-selected HMM samples are fitted without a return-count or state-mass quota
Feature oracle: price momentum, average-tie relative rank, signed trend and reversal
Manual mapping records assumed horizon returns; scores are not implicit percentages
Ridge analytic solution, training scaler and a single observation have no sample quota
Ridge label oracle matches prior-cutoff, decision then next-close fills and excludes pending outcomes
Explicit policy selection is validated; isolated capital cannot receive a portfolio quality policy
Known ranking/PCA oracle, null first stability, exact training coverage and policy identity
Constant cross-sectional ranking blocks ON before optimization, OFF only observes
Missing input, stale last quote and future observations are explicit, never filled
Direct asset returns do not invent signal PCA or a cross-sectional selection requirement
Rank reversal is a warning, not a portfolio substitution; history is cutoff/window bounded
SGOV interval convention fails closed on holes, including the previous observation
Current policy forces exactly zero and rejects missing, historical, positive or extra cash inputs
Zero cash is independent of SGOV history and values, excludes To, and does not invent intervals
Zero-cash ledger reconciles all-cash and invested positions, real fees, slippage and drift
Independent tiny ledger oracle: cash accrues before execution, holdings drift without implicit trades
Fee/slippage oracle is based on actual fills; all-cash reference has zero excess Sharpe variance
Mandate violations reject rather than fix solver weights or transfer cash
Twenty candidates and an 8–12 final-holdings mandate are accepted, without clamping or input mutation
Candidate duplicates and empty candidates are rejected with a specific actionable reason
Feasibility identifies the exact conflicting holding constraints
Weight-floor conflicts and required invested capital are checked before execution
A low maximum-weight capacity does not require full investment or silently change inputs
2.5% and 3% strategic floors do not impose a minimum capital-overlay exposure
100% ceiling plus 100% stress reduction is valid in Daily mode, including full-cash targets
Final targets must satisfy holdings and weight requirements; nothing is truncated or raised
The continuous objective and weight solution remain unchanged for existing valid inputs
Backtest summary separates candidates, final holdings, cash return and investment ceilings
Conflicting constraints are highlighted at their exact summary rows, with a specific fix
No mandate is described without inventing a minimum or guaranteed number of holdings
Mandate summary distinguishes strategic construction floors from permitted HMM scaling and drift
Final-holdings fields allow more than eight without silently clamping the mandate
Capital policy explains the valid 100%-stress reduction without implying cash allocation is zero
